candidate.user_submission: Di child no dey convulse now. Dem no see any convulsion before. Di child no dey weak or unconscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. Di pikin na 18 months old. E get cough or dey find am hard to breathe. E no get diarrhoea. E no get wahala for ear. E no get fever. Dem count di breath for one full minute. Dem do bronchodilator trial finish. E chest no dey draw inside. Di child calm when dem dey check am. Di cough don last for 3 days. After dem give bronchodilator, dem count di breath for one full minute again. E chest still no dey draw inside after di bronchodilator. Di child still calm after di bronchodilator. After bronchodilator, di respiratory rate na 42 per minute. Pulse oximeter no dey available. E no dey get recurrent wheeze. Di respiratory rate before bronchodilator na 45 per minute. E no get stridor when e calm. Dem observe wheezing.
